rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when directing attention, effort, or concern toward a task or topic.

example.english: Today we focus on this issue.
example.traditional: 我哋今日集中討論呢個問題。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 zaap6 zung1 tou2 leon6 ni1 go3 man6 tai4

rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose noun for the main thing receiving attention or effort.

example.english: The focus of this report is improving the service.
example.traditional: 呢份報告嘅重點係改善服務。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 zung6 dim2 hai6 goi2 sin6 fuk6 mou6

rows.note: Use this for the optical focal point in photography (sense 2), or for a person or topic singled out for attention (the corresponding slice of sense 5).

example.english: After focusing, the focus landed on the petals.
example.traditional: 對焦之後，個焦點落咗喺花瓣度。
example.jyutping: deoi3 ziu1 zi1 hau6 go3 ziu1 dim2 lok6 zo2 hai2 faa1 baan6 dou6

rows.note: Use this for a person's ability or degree of concentrated attention.

example.english: You need focus to do your homework, so don't look at your phone at the same time.
example.traditional: 做功課要有專注力，唔好一路睇手機。
example.jyutping: zou6 gung1 fo3 jiu3 jau5 zyun1 zyu3 lik6 m4 hou2 jat1 lou6 tai2 sau2 gei1

rows.note: Use this when explicitly saying that someone should concentrate their attention.

example.english: In class, don't get distracted; focus your attention on the lesson.
example.traditional: 上堂唔好分心，要集中注意力聽書。
example.jyutping: soeng6 tong4 m4 hou2 fan1 sam1 jiu3 zaap6 zung1 zyu3 ji3 lik6 teng1 syu1

rows.note: Use this specifically for adjusting a camera, microscope, or other optical instrument so the image is sharp.

example.english: The camera still didn't focus, so the photo came out completely blurry.
example.traditional: 部相機仲未對焦，影出嚟張相矇晒。
example.jyutping: bou6 soeng2 gei1 zung6 mei6 deoi3 ziu1 jing2 ceot1 lai4 zoeng1 soeng2 mung4 saai3
